name: Young Tornado Dragon

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Whirling Winds
traits.details: The dragon has partial concealment against any enemy in the aura.

auras.name: Whirling Winds
auras.details: The dragon has partial concealment against any enemy in the aura.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 5 lightning damage (save ends).

effect.description: The dragon uses bite and claw or uses claw twice.

powers.name: Expanding Aura
powers.usageDetails: when the dragon starts its turn and its whirling winds is smaller than aura 5

effect.description: The whirling winds aura expands by 2 squares.

powers.name: Twister Unleashed
powers.usageDetails: when the dragon starts its turn and its whirling winds is aura 5

effect.description: Any effect on the dragon that includes the immobilized, restrained, or slowed condition ends. The dragon becomes insubstantial and shifts up to its speed, and it can move through enemies’ spaces. Each time the dragon enters an enemy’s space for the first time during this movement, it can use bite against that enemy. On a hit, the dragon slides the target up to 2 squares and the target falls prone.
The dragon’s whirling winds reverts to aura 1.

powers.name: Storm Twist
powers.trigger: The dragon takes lightning or thunder damage.

effect.description: The dragon becomes insubstantial and can shift up to its speed.
